findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?source=mcp_registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_shop_nobi_page, get_product_details · Public sink: search_products, find_shop_nobi_page, get_product_details, compare_products, check_price_and_availability, find_alternatives, about_mcp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_shop_nobi_page, get_product_details · Public sink: search_products, find_shop_nobi_page, get_product_details, compare_products, check_price_and_availability, find_alternatives, about_mcp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
